verses.original: כִּֽי־ יִקַּ֥ח אִ֛ישׁ וּבְעָלָ֑הּ וְהָיָ֞ה אִשָּׁ֖ה אִם־ לֹ֧א תִמְצָא־ חֵ֣ן בְּעֵינָ֗יו כִּי־ מָ֤צָא דָּבָ֔ר עֶרְוַ֣ת בָהּ֙ וְכָ֨תַב לָ֜הּ סֵ֤פֶר כְּרִיתֻת֙ וְנָתַ֣ן בְּיָדָ֔הּ וְשִׁלְּחָ֖הּ מִבֵּיתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- yiq·qaḥ ’îš ū·ḇə·‘ā·lāh wə·hā·yāh ’iš·šāh ’im- lō ṯim·ṣā- ḥên bə·‘ê·nāw kî- mā·ṣā dā·ḇār ‘er·waṯ ḇāh wə·ḵā·ṯaḇ lāh sê·p̄er kə·rî·ṯuṯ wə·nā·ṯan bə·yā·ḏāh wə·šil·lə·ḥāh mib·bê·ṯōw
verses.literal: If . . . a man marries . . . a woman but she becomes displeasing . . . . . . . . . to him because he finds some indecency in her he may write her a certificate of divorce hand it to her and send her away from his house

verses.original: וְיָצְאָ֖ה מִבֵּית֑וֹ וְהָלְכָ֖ה וְהָיְתָ֥ה אַחֵֽר׃ לְאִישׁ־
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·ṣə·’āh mib·bê·ṯōw wə·hā·lə·ḵāh wə·hā·yə·ṯāh ’a·ḥêr lə·’îš-
verses.literal: If, after leaving his house she goes and becomes another man’s wife

verses.original: הָאַחֲרוֹן֒ הָאִ֣ישׁ וּשְׂנֵאָהּ֮ וְכָ֨תַב לָ֜הּ סֵ֤פֶר כְּרִיתֻת֙ וְנָתַ֣ן בְּיָדָ֔הּ וְשִׁלְּחָ֖הּ מִבֵּית֑וֹ א֣וֹ כִ֤י יָמוּת֙ הָאִ֣ישׁ הָאַחֲר֔וֹן אֲשֶׁר־ לְקָחָ֥הּ ל֖וֹ לְאִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: hā·’a·ḥă·rō·wn hā·’îš ū·śə·nê·’āh wə·ḵā·ṯaḇ lāh sê·p̄er kə·rî·ṯuṯ wə·nā·ṯan bə·yā·ḏāh wə·šil·lə·ḥāh mib·bê·ṯōw ’ōw ḵî yā·mūṯ hā·’îš hā·’a·ḥă·rō·wn ’ă·šer- lə·qā·ḥāh lōw lə·’iš·šāh
verses.literal: and the second man hates her writes her a certificate of divorce hands it to her and sends her away from his house or if he dies . . . . . . - - -

verses.original: בַּעְלָ֣הּ אֲשֶֽׁר־ שִׁ֠לְּחָהּ הָרִאשׁ֣וֹן יוּכַ֣ל לֹא־ לָשׁ֨וּב לְקַחְתָּ֜הּ לִהְי֧וֹת ל֣וֹ לְאִשָּׁ֗ה אַחֲרֵי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֻטַּמָּ֔אָה כִּֽי־ הִ֖וא תוֹעֵבָ֥ה לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְלֹ֤א תַחֲטִיא֙ אֶת־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לְךָ֖ נַחֲלָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ba‘·lāh ’ă·še·rō·ši- šil·lə·ḥāh hā·ri·šō·wn yū·ḵal lō- lā·šūḇ lə·qaḥ·tāh lih·yō·wṯ lōw lə·’iš·šāh ’a·ḥă·rê ’ă·šer huṭ·ṭam·mā·’āh kî- hî ṯō·w·‘ê·ḇāh lip̄·nê Yah·weh wə·lō ṯa·ḥă·ṭî ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā nō·ṯên lə·ḵā na·ḥă·lāh
verses.literal: then the husband who divorced her first may not vvv remarry . . . . . . her after - she has been defiled for that [is] an abomination to the LORD You must not bring sin - upon the land that the LORD your God is giving you [as] an inheritance

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אִישׁ֙ חֲדָשָׁ֔ה יִקַּ֥ח אִשָּׁ֣ה לֹ֤א יֵצֵא֙ בַּצָּבָ֔א וְלֹא־ יַעֲבֹ֥ר עָלָ֖יו לְכָל־ דָּבָ֑ר אֶחָ֔ת שָׁנָ֣ה יִהְיֶ֤ה נָקִ֞י לְבֵיתוֹ֙ וְשִׂמַּ֖ח אֶת־ אִשְׁתּ֥וֹ אֲשֶׁר־ לָקָֽח׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî- ’îš ḥă·ḏā·šāh yiq·qaḥ ’iš·šāh lō yê·ṣê baṣ·ṣā·ḇā wə·lō- ya·‘ă·ḇōr ‘ā·lāw lə·ḵāl dā·ḇār ’e·ḥāṯ šā·nāh yih·yeh nā·qî lə·ḇê·ṯōw wə·śim·maḥ ’eṯ- ’iš·tōw ’ă·šer- lā·qāḥ
verses.literal: If a man is newly married . . . he must not be sent to war or be pressed into any duty For one year he is free to stay at home and bring joy - to the wife - he has married

verses.original: לֹא־ רֵחַ֖יִם וָרָ֑כֶב יַחֲבֹ֥ל כִּי־ ה֥וּא נֶ֖פֶשׁ חֹבֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: lō- rê·ḥa·yim wā·rā·ḵeḇ ya·ḥă·ḇōl kî- hū ne·p̄eš ḥō·ḇêl
verses.literal: Do not take a pair of millstones or even an upper millstone as security for a debt because that would be taking one’s livelihood as security

verses.original: כִּי־ אִ֗ישׁ יִמָּצֵ֣א גֹּנֵ֨ב נֶ֤פֶשׁ מִבְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מֵאֶחָיו֙ וְהִתְעַמֶּר־ בּ֖וֹ וּמְכָר֑וֹ הַה֔וּא הַגַּנָּ֣ב וּמֵת֙ וּבִֽעַרְתָּ֥ הָרָ֖ע מִקִּרְבֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ’îš yim·mā·ṣê gō·nêḇ ne·p̄eš mib·bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl mê·’e·ḥāw wə·hiṯ·‘am·mer- bōw ū·mə·ḵā·rōw ha·hū hag·gan·nāḇ ū·mêṯ ū·ḇi·‘ar·tā hā·rā‘ miq·qir·be·ḵā
verses.literal: If a man is caught kidnapping one of his Israelite . . . brothers whether he treats him as a slave or sells him the kidnapper must die So you must purge the evil from among you

verses.original: בְּנֶֽגַע־ הַצָּרַ֛עַת הִשָּׁ֧מֶר לִשְׁמֹ֥ר וְלַעֲשׂ֑וֹת מְאֹ֖ד כְּכֹל֩ אֲשֶׁר־ הַלְוִיִּ֛ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר הַכֹּהֲנִ֧ים יוֹר֨וּ אֶתְכֶ֜ם תִּשְׁמְר֥וּ לַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃ס צִוִּיתִ֖ם
verses.transliteration: bə·ne·ḡa‘- haṣ·ṣā·ra·‘aṯ hiš·šā·mer liš·mōr wə·la·‘ă·śō·wṯ mə·’ōḏ kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- hal·wî·yim ka·’ă·šer hak·kō·hă·nîm yō·w·rū ’eṯ·ḵem tiš·mə·rū la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ṣiw·wî·ṯim
verses.literal: In cases of infectious skin diseases be careful to diligently follow . . . everything the Levitical - priests instruct you Be careful to do as I have commanded them

verses.original: זָכ֕וֹר אֵ֧ת אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ עָשָׂ֛ה לְמִרְיָ֑ם בַּדֶּ֖רֶךְ בְּצֵאתְכֶ֥ם מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃ס
verses.transliteration: zā·ḵō·wr ’êṯ ’ă·šer- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ‘ā·śāh lə·mir·yām bad·de·reḵ bə·ṣê·ṯə·ḵem mim·miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: Remember - what the LORD your God did to Miriam on the journey after you came out of Egypt

verses.original: כִּֽי־ תַשֶּׁ֥ה מַשַּׁ֣את מְא֑וּמָה בְרֵֽעֲךָ לֹא־ תָבֹ֥א אֶל־ בֵּית֖וֹ לַעֲבֹ֥ט עֲבֹטֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ṯaš·šeh maš·šaṯ mə·’ū·māh ḇə·rē·ʿă·ḵå̄ lō- ṯā·ḇō ’el- bê·ṯōw la·‘ă·ḇōṭ ‘ă·ḇō·ṭōw
verses.literal: When you lend anything . . . to your neighbor do not enter . . . his house to collect security

verses.original: תַּעֲמֹ֑ד בַּח֖וּץ וְהָאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר אַתָּה֙ נֹשֶׁ֣ה ב֔וֹ יוֹצִ֥יא הַעֲב֖וֹט הַחֽוּצָה׃ אֵלֶ֛יךָ אֶֽת־
verses.transliteration: ta·‘ă·mōḏ ba·ḥūṣ wə·hā·’îš ’ă·šer ’at·tāh nō·šeh ḇōw yō·w·ṣî ha·‘ă·ḇō·wṭ ha·ḥū·ṣāh ’ê·le·ḵā ’eṯ-
verses.literal: You are to stand outside while the man - to whom you are lending brings the security out to you -

verses.original: וְאִם־ ה֑וּא עָנִ֖י אִ֥ישׁ לֹ֥א תִשְׁכַּ֖ב בַּעֲבֹטֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- hū ‘ā·nî ’îš lō ṯiš·kaḇ ba·‘ă·ḇō·ṭōw
verses.literal: If he is a poor man you must not go to sleep with the security {in your possession}

verses.original: הָשֵׁב֩ תָּשִׁ֨יב אֶֽת־ הַעֲבוֹט֙ ל֤וֹ כְּבֹ֣א הַשֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ וְשָׁכַ֥ב בְּשַׂלְמָת֖וֹ וּבֵֽרֲכֶ֑ךָּ תִּהְיֶ֣ה צְדָקָ֔ה וּלְךָ֙ לִפְנֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃ס
verses.transliteration: hā·šêḇ tā·šîḇ ’eṯ- ha·‘ă·ḇō·wṭ lōw kə·ḇō haš·še·meš wə·šā·ḵaḇ bə·śal·mā·ṯōw ū·ḇê·ră·ḵe·kā tih·yeh ṣə·ḏā·qāh ū·lə·ḵā lip̄·nê Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā
verses.literal: be sure to return . . . - [it] to him by sunset . . . so that he may sleep in his own cloak and bless you and this will be credited to you as righteousness . . . before the LORD your God

verses.original: לֹא־ תַעֲשֹׁ֥ק שָׂכִ֖יר עָנִ֣י וְאֶבְי֑וֹן מֵאַחֶ֕יךָ א֧וֹ מִגֵּרְךָ֛ אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּשְׁעָרֶֽיךָ׃ בְּאַרְצְךָ֖
verses.transliteration: lō- ṯa·‘ă·šōq śā·ḵîr ‘ā·nî wə·’eḇ·yō·wn mê·’a·ḥe·ḵā ’ōw mig·gê·rə·ḵā ’ă·šer biš·‘ā·re·ḵā bə·’ar·ṣə·ḵā
verses.literal: Do not oppress a hired hand who is poor and needy [whether] he is a brother or a foreigner residing - in one of your towns

verses.original: תִתֵּ֨ן שְׂכָר֜וֹ בְּיוֹמוֹ֩ וְֽלֹא־ הַשֶּׁ֗מֶשׁ תָב֧וֹא עָלָ֣יו כִּ֤י ה֔וּא וְאֵלָ֕יו ה֥וּא עָנִי֙ נֹשֵׂ֖א אֶת־ נַפְשׁ֑וֹ אֶל־ וְלֹֽא־ יִקְרָ֤א יְהוָ֔ה עָלֶ֙יךָ֙ וְהָיָ֥ה בְךָ֖ חֵֽטְא׃ס
verses.transliteration: ṯit·tên śə·ḵā·rōw bə·yō·w·mōw wə·lō- haš·še·meš ṯā·ḇō·w ‘ā·lāw kî hū wə·’ê·lāw hū ‘ā·nî nō·śê ’eṯ- nap̄·šōw ’el- wə·lō- yiq·rā Yah·weh ‘ā·le·ḵā wə·hā·yāh ḇə·ḵā ḥêṭ
verses.literal: You are to pay his wages each day before sunset . . . because he . . . . . . is poor and depends - - on them Otherwise he may cry out to the LORD against you . . . and you will be guilty of sin

verses.original: אָבוֹת֙ לֹֽא־ יוּמְת֤וּ עַל־ בָּנִ֔ים וּבָנִ֖ים לֹא־ יוּמְת֣וּ עַל־ אָב֑וֹת אִ֥יש יוּמָֽתוּ׃ס בְּחֶטְא֖וֹ
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḇō·wṯ lō- yū·mə·ṯū ‘al- bā·nîm ū·ḇā·nîm lō- yū·mə·ṯū ‘al- ’ā·ḇō·wṯ ʾīš yū·mā·ṯū bə·ḥeṭ·’ōw
verses.literal: Fathers shall not be put to death for their children nor children . . . - for their fathers each is to die for his own sin

verses.original: לֹ֣א תַטֶּ֔ה מִשְׁפַּ֖ט גֵּ֣ר יָת֑וֹם וְלֹ֣א אַלְמָנָֽה׃ בֶּ֖גֶד תַחֲבֹ֔ל
verses.transliteration: lō ṯaṭ·ṭeh miš·paṭ gêr yā·ṯō·wm wə·lō ’al·mā·nāh be·ḡeḏ ṯa·ḥă·ḇōl
verses.literal: Do not deny justice to the foreigner or the fatherless and do not take a widow’s cloak as security

verses.original: וְזָכַרְתָּ֗ כִּ֣י הָיִ֙יתָ֙ עֶ֤בֶד בְּמִצְרַ֔יִם יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ וַֽיִּפְדְּךָ֛ מִשָּׁ֑ם עַל־ כֵּ֞ן אָנֹכִ֤י מְצַוְּךָ֙ לַעֲשׂ֔וֹת אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֖ר הַזֶּֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·zā·ḵar·tā kî hā·yî·ṯā ‘e·ḇeḏ bə·miṣ·ra·yim Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā way·yip̄·də·ḵā miš·šām ‘al- kên ’ā·nō·ḵî mə·ṣaw·wə·ḵā la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ’eṯ- had·dā·ḇār haz·zeh
verses.literal: Remember that you were slaves in Egypt and the LORD your God redeemed you from that place Therefore . . . I am commanding you to do - - this

verses.original: כִּ֣י תִקְצֹר֩ קְצִֽירְךָ֨ בְשָׂדֶ֜ךָ וְשָֽׁכַחְתָּ֧ עֹ֣מֶר בַּשָּׂדֶ֗ה לֹ֤א תָשׁוּב֙ לְקַחְתּ֔וֹ יִהְיֶ֑ה לַגֵּ֛ר לַיָּת֥וֹם וְלָאַלְמָנָ֖ה לְמַ֤עַן יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ יְבָרֶכְךָ֙ בְּכֹ֖ל מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יָדֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ṯiq·ṣōr qə·ṣî·rə·ḵā ḇə·śā·ḏe·ḵā wə·šā·ḵaḥ·tā ‘ō·mer baś·śā·ḏeh lō ṯā·šūḇ lə·qaḥ·tōw yih·yeh lag·gêr lay·yā·ṯō·wm wə·lā·’al·mā·nāh lə·ma·‘an Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā yə·ḇā·reḵ·ḵā bə·ḵōl ma·‘ă·śêh yā·ḏe·ḵā
verses.literal: If you are harvesting . . . in your field and forget a sheaf [there] do not go back to get it It is to be left for the foreigner the fatherless and the widow so that the LORD your God may bless you in all the work of your hands

verses.original: כִּ֤י תַחְבֹּט֙ זֵֽיתְךָ֔ לֹ֥א תְפָאֵ֖ר אַחֲרֶ֑יךָ יִהְיֶֽה׃ס לַגֵּ֛ר לַיָּת֥וֹם וְלָאַלְמָנָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: kî ṯaḥ·bōṭ zê·ṯə·ḵā lō ṯə·p̄ā·’êr ’a·ḥă·re·ḵā yih·yeh lag·gêr lay·yā·ṯō·wm wə·lā·’al·mā·nāh
verses.literal: When you beat the olives from your trees you must not go over the branches again What remains will be for the foreigner the fatherless and the widow

verses.original: כִּ֤י תִבְצֹר֙ כַּרְמְךָ֔ לֹ֥א תְעוֹלֵ֖ל אַחֲרֶ֑יךָ יִהְיֶֽה׃ לַגֵּ֛ר לַיָּת֥וֹם וְלָאַלְמָנָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: kî ṯiḇ·ṣōr kar·mə·ḵā lō ṯə·‘ō·w·lêl ’a·ḥă·re·ḵā yih·yeh lag·gêr lay·yā·ṯō·wm wə·lā·’al·mā·nāh
verses.literal: When you gather the grapes of your vineyard you must not go over [the vines] again What remains will be for the foreigner the fatherless and the widow

verses.original: וְזָ֣כַרְתָּ֔ כִּי־ הָיִ֖יתָ עֶ֥בֶד בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם עַל־ כֵּ֞ן אָנֹכִ֤י מְצַוְּךָ֙ לַעֲשׂ֔וֹת אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֖ר הַזֶּֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·zā·ḵar·tā kî- hā·yî·ṯā ‘e·ḇeḏ bə·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim ‘al- kên ’ā·nō·ḵî mə·ṣaw·wə·ḵā la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ’eṯ- had·dā·ḇār haz·zeh
verses.literal: Remember that you were slaves in the land of Egypt Therefore . . . I am commanding you to do - - this
